--- Sheet: Product Requirements ---
	SWITCH  REQUIREMENT
1.1	HARDWARE / SOFTWARE SPECIFICATIONS		Explanation	Response
1.1.1	LICENCE	Product licensing should be stated in detail. Software updates should be provided free of charge by the supplier, and information on which software will be provided for the products taken into stock should be stated.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.2	PERFORMANCE SPECIFICATIONS
1.1.2.1	MEMORY AND CPU PERFORMANCE	Each network element must support enough CPU and memory performance to cover any loop incident. Please describe details.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.2.2	THROUPUT CAPACITY	Each network element must support 1:1 interface throuput with full duplex. Please describe details.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.2.3	BACKPLANE CAPACITY	Each network element must support 1:1 backplane capacity support. Please describe details.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.2.4	PRODUCT LIFE CYCLE	Specify the life cycle and duration of the recommended product, and guarantee that the EoS product will be replaced with an equivalent product. Share the road map information of the product.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3	INTERFACE SPECIFICATIONS
1.1.3.1	PHYSICAL INTERFACES	The equipment must support SFP+, BIDI, 1000BASE-T and PON SFP with speed 1 Gbps or 10 Gbps    Must be able to work with OEM SFP.                                                                                                                                                                                                         Minimum 24 x1G Cupper or SFP based ethernet interface, The equipment must also have a minimum of 4 x10G ethernet ports, and each port must be able to provide the speed it supports independently.	PON SFP's are not supported	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.2	BUFFER SIZE	Please specify the equipment’s buffer size and if it can change manually		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.3	CONSOLE INTERFACE	The equipment must have console port for connecting via PC for management and configuration.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.4	POWER SPECIFICATIONS	The equipment must have pluggable and hot swap redundant AC or DC power supply.	Dual AC or DC power supplies available.
No hotpluggable power modules available.	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.5	OPERATING ENVIRONMENTAL SPECIFICATIONS	Operating temperature must be –40 to 70ºC	Operating temperature lies between -20 to 70C	NON COMPLIANT
1.1.3.6	DIMENSIONS	The equipment must be 1U. Please specify dimensions of the equipment in detail.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.7	FLASH CAPACITY	The network element MUST be able to store two software in same time for next 3 year. Additional Notes: Minimum internal flash MUST be 128 Mbyte.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.1.3.8	USB INTERFACE	Specify usb interface capacity for file transfer		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2	LAYER 2/3  SPECIFICATIONS
1.2.1	IEEE 802.1Q	The network element MUST support VLAN transport according IEEE 802.1Q. Full range of 4096 tags SHOULD be supported.	4093 vlan tags are available	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.2.2	NATIVE VLAN	Traffic on one particular VLAN MUST remain untagged (native VLAN described in IEEE 802.1Q). Any VLAN from supported range MUST be native eligible and different UNI ports can have different native VLAN.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.3	802.1Q TUNNELING	The network element MUST support 802.1q tunneling. Please describe vlan transport mechanism.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.4	SELECTIVE QinQ	The network element MUST support support Selective QinQ.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.5	QinQ	The network element MUST support QinQ configuration under sub-interfaces and virtual interfaces.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.6	VLAN TRANSLATION	The network element MUST support vlan translation.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.7	LAG (LACP)	The network element MUST support LACP (8 bit load-sharing).		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.8	MC-LAG	The network element MUST support multi-chassis LAG.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.9	STACK	1 and 10Gb ports must include stack support. Provide product detail and support.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10	LOOP PROTECTION			FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.1	IEEE 802.1D STP SUPPORT	STP (Spanning Tree Protocol) MUST be supported as defined in 802.1D.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.2	IEEE 802.1W RSTP SUPPORT	RSTP (Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol) MUST be supported as defined in 802.1w.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.3	IEEE 802.1S MSTP SUPPORT	MSTP (Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol) MUST be supported as defined in 802.1S.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.4	STP ROOT-PROTECTION	The network element must stp root-protection feature. Please describe in details.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.5	STP PROCESS SUPPORT	The network element must support stp process feature. Please describe in details.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.10.6	STP LOOP PROTECTION	Loop protection mechanisms MUST be included. MSTP (Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol) MUST be supported as defined in IEEE 802.1s.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.11	IEEE 802.3x	The network element MUST support IEEE 802.3x Flow Control.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.12	MAC-LEARNING PRIORITY	The network element must support mac-learning priority or equivalent feature. Please describe in details		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.13	ETHERNET HOLD TIMERS	The network element MUST be able detect link flaps and put the interface up and down timer to provide more stable L2 network.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.14	UNIDIRECTIONAL LINK DETECTION	The network elements MUST be able to detect unidirectional optical link (one optical fibre inactive from some reason in pair or cabling mismatch). Please describe detection algorithm in detail.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.15	MTU	The equipment must have jumbo frame support (9000).		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.16	LLDP	The equipment must support Link Layer Discovery Protocol as defined in IEEE 802.1AB.		FULLY COMPLIANT
1.2.17	IP LAYER SERVICES	Network Address Translation (NAT)
Port Address Translation (PAT)
Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) server, relay, client
DHCP Option
Dynamic Domain Name System (DNS)
DNS Proxy
DNS Spoofing
Access control lists (ACLs , ACL  Group , vrf base ACL group )
Virtual Route Forwarding (VRF) Lite
Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD)	VRF Lite is not supported
BFD is not supported
NAT is not supported	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.2.18	STATIC ROUTING	The Router must support static routing with “tracking” extensions. VRF route must support	Tracking will be available in 2024 Q1	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.3	SECURITY SPECIFICATIONS
1.3.1	CONTROL PLANE  POLICY	The equipment must have control plane policy. Please describe in details.	The device software have built in cpp protection
 that prevents device to be broken under cpu targeted attacks	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.3.2	CPU DEFEND  POLICY	The equipment must have CPU defend policy. Please describe in details.	The device software have built in cpp protection
that prevents device to be broken under cpu targeted attacks	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.3.3	PORT SECURITY	The equipment must have port security features. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.4	STORM CONTROL	The equipment must have broadcast and multicast storm control. Please describe in details		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.5	IEEE 802.1X SUPPORT	The equipment must have network access control as defined in 802.1X. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.6	TRAFFIC FILTERING	The equipment must have ingress and egress Layer 2 and Layer 3 traffic-filter and traffic-policy. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.6.1	IP ADDRESS FILTERING	The equipment must have IP access list support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.6.2	MAC ADDRESS FILTERING	The equipment must have MAC access list support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.7	PRIVATE VLAN	The equipment must have private vlan support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.8	DHCP SNOOPING	The equipment must have DHCP snooping support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.9	ARP INSPECTION	The equipment must have ARP inspection support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.10	DHCP OPTION	The equipment must have dhcp option support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.3.11	BPDU GUARD / FILTERING	The equipment must have bpdu guard and filtering on UNI ports support. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.4	L2 / L3 QoS SPECIFICATIONS
1.4.1	PRIORITIZATION / QUEUING	The equipment must have packet prioritization in hardware. Minimum eight queues, scheduling, shaping, policing and queue mapping  must be supported. Assigning packet to the queue must be possible at least on one criteria CoS (802.1P), ToS, DSCP with marking. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.4.2	QoS TYPES	The equipment must support QoS types below. Please describe in details                                                                                                             Qos PQ on uplink  
Qos WRR on uplink  
Qos PQ on downlink  
Qos WRR on downlink  
Both multicast and unicast options shall support QoS marking capability per operator choice.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.5	MULTICAST
1.5.1	SPECIFICATIONS	The equipment must support multicast features below. Please describe in details.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          IGMPv2 snooping  
IGMPv3 snooping  
PIM SSM  
PIM sparse mode  
PIM sparse dense mode    	PIM Convergence    	IGMP Fast Leave ?  
IGMP Proxy  
MVR Multicast Vlan Registration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Ethernet multicast option shall support both VLAN and untagged options. Using a VLAN for multicast shall be operator configurable  
Multicast VPN	L3 multicast protocols such as PIM are not supported	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
1.6	NETWORK MANAGEMENT
1.6.1	NMS	Smart network management system including central service creation and operation and monitoring must be supported. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.2	OPENFLOW	The equipment must support  Netflow , OpenFlow. Please describe in details.	Sflow which provide necessary functions to cover netflow is supported. 
Openflow is not supported in proposed hardware	NON COMPLIANT
1.6.3	NETWORK PERFORMANCE AND SERVICE INVENTORY	Network performance and service inventory must be provided and implemented by tenderer. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.4	IEEE 802.3ah - OAM	The equipment must support  IEEE 802.3ah standard for Operation, Administration, and Management (OAM). Please describe in details		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.5	802.1ag – CFM	The equipment must support  IEEE 802.1ag (also CFM). Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.6	ITU-T Y.1731	The equipment must support  ITU-T Y.1731 for performance management. Please describe in details.		NON COMPLIANT
1.6.7	SNMP	The equipment must support SNMP-V2 / V3 MIBS , TRAPS and access-list. All of the MIBs must be given to Turkcell. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.8	TWAMP	The equipment must support  Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (TWAMP).		NON COMPLIANT
1.6.9	RTR Tracking	The equipment must support  RTR Tracking feature. Please describe details		NON COMPLIANT
1.6.10	REMOTE ACCESS	The equipment must support Telnet, SSHv2, SSHv3 Web Interface for remote management. Please describe in details. Also privileged levels and source IP restriction must be supported. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.11	SYSLOG	The equipment must support syslog to send events to the syslog server. Please describe in details.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.12	CLI	The equipment must have command line interface (SSH, Telnet).		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.13	PROOF OF CONCEPT	POC, Service HLD-LLD and FNI must be included to the project.		FULL COMPLIANT
1.6.14	MANAGEMENT	Performance Monitoring Features (Jitter, Delay, MOS ..etc.)
AAA
RADIUS and TACACS+ (  RSA can be used for services such as digital signatures  )
Out-of-band management 
RMON
Network traffic monitoring (flow capture and record)
NTP ( Network Time Protocol )
Local packet capturing (wireshark) on switch for debugging
SNMP V2,V3 ,TR-069 , TR-064 , TR-098 ,TR-111 , TR-104 protocol support , 
Netconf  / Yang
IPfix
Comparing SSH Keys - RSA hash must be support SHA 512	Netconf and YANG is not supported. 
Local packet capturing is not supported
Sflow is supported instead of IPFIX
TR portocols are not supported. Angora own zero touch provisioning system can be used for remote deployments	PARTIALLY COMPLIANT
